name: Canvas Low-Top Sneaker
description: A minimalist canvas low-top sneaker in heathered off-white cotton canvas with a natural gum rubber sole and toe cap, cotton laces, and brass eyelets.
materials: heathered cotton canvas upper, natural gum rubber sole and toe cap, cotton laces, brass eyelets
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, tab, patch, or printed/woven lettering anywhere on the shoe; never add lugged tread to the sole, it stays smooth ribbed vulcanized gum rubber; never flatten the canvas into a solid uniform color, it must keep its heathered fleck
preservationNotes: keep the gum rubber sole translucent honey-tan, never painted solid white or grey, and keep the canvas weave's heathered two-tone flecking visible up close across every angle; keep all surfaces entirely plain and unmarked
